_comment: Story-so-far recaps (gamecmn story_*.bxon), fan translation, 5 lines max.

tm.大切な儀式を控えた {var:1}は\n少女とともに とある岩山を目指し歩きだす:
With an important rite of passage ahead,
{var:1} sets off with a young girl
towards a rocky peak. Its sheer cliffs tower
high and treacherous, as if to test the pair.
tm.１６歳の誕生日を迎えた者が 神の岩に登り\n大地の精霊に 祈りを捧げる……。\n:
Those who turn sixteen must climb
Cobblestone Tor and pray to the Spirit of
the Land... Born on the same day,
{var:1} and childhood friend Gemma are
to face the rite together.
tm.道中で 襲いかかってきた魔物を倒した\n{var:1}は 神の岩の頂上を目指し\:
Having fought off the monsters that
attacked on the way, {var:1} presses on
towards the summit of the Tor...
tm.頂上に たどり着いた ふたりは\n魔物の襲撃に あったものの\n突然の 落雷に助:
Reaching the summit, the pair are attacked
by a monster, but a sudden bolt of lightning
saves them.
tm.大地の精霊に 祈りを捧げ\n無事に イシの村へ戻った ふたりは\n神の岩の頂上で:
Having prayed to the Spirit of the Land and
returned safely to Cobblestone, the pair tell
Chief Dunstan what happened at the
summit.
tm.それを聞いた ダンは {var:1}とエマに\nロトゼタシアの広大さを 伝えると:
Dunstan reveals the true meaning of the
rite: to show {var:1} and Gemma how
vast Erdrea is. The pair then go to tell
{var:1}'s mother Amber that the rite is
complete.
tm.大地の精霊に 祈りを捧げ\n無事に イシの村へ戻った ふたりは\n神の岩で ふた:
Having prayed to the Spirit of the Land and
returned safely to Cobblestone, the pair tell
Amber about the strange lightning that
saved them on the Tor.
tm.それを聞いた ペルラは {var:1}に\nお前は 勇者の生まれ変わりだと\n今:
Hearing this, Amber reveals the truth she
has hidden all along: {var:1} is the
Luminary reborn. Stunned by the news,
{var:1} spends a sleepless night...
tm.自分は 勇者の生まれ変わりである……。\n成人の儀式を終えた {var:1}が:
"I am the Luminary reborn..." This was the
astonishing truth {var:1} heard from
Amber after the coming-of-age rite.
tm.その使命を果たすため 村を出ることになり\n眠れぬ夜を過ごしていた {var:1:
Unable to sleep before leaving to fulfil this
destiny, {var:1} hears the legend of the
Luminary's star from Gemma beneath their
tree, then wakes to the morning of
departure...
tm.その使命を 果たすため\n村を 出ることになった {var:1}は\n村中の人々:
To fulfil this destiny, {var:1} leaves the
village, seen off by everyone, and heads for
the kingdom of Heliodor to the north...
tm.その使命を 果たすため\n村を出た {var:1}は\n北にある デルカダール王:
Leaving the village to fulfil this destiny,
{var:1} reaches the kingdom of Heliodor
to the north and enters Heliodor Castle to
meet the King.
tm.自分は 勇者の生まれ変わりである。\nその事実を知った {var:1}は\n自ら:
Learning of being the Luminary reborn,
{var:1} leaves Cobblestone to fulfil that
destiny and arrives in the kingdom of
Heliodor to the north.
tm.ついに デルカダール王との謁見がかなったが\n王は {var:1}の素性を知ると:
At last {var:1} meets the King, who,
learning who {var:1} is, declares the
Luminary an enemy of the land. {var:1}
is seized by General Hendrik and thrown
into the dungeon...
tm.無事 王との謁見を果たした {var:1}だったが\n勇者こそ この大地に あだ:
{var:1} meets the King, only to be
branded the Darkspawn, a bringer of
disaster, and thrown in jail. Then, in the
gloomy dungeon, a mysterious hooded
youth appears before {var:1}.
tm.謎の青年は 見張りの兵士から 奪ったカギで\n{var:1}を 牢から出すと\n:
The mysterious youth frees {var:1} with
a key stolen from a guard, and says to
come and find him...
tm.謎の青年の助けにより\n牢を出て 荷物を取り返した {var:1}は\n青年とと:
With the mysterious youth's help, {var:1}
escapes the cell and recovers their
belongings, then tries to flee with the
youth...
tm.謎の青年の助けにより{x:000A}牢を出て 荷物を取り返した {var:1}は:
With the mysterious youth's help, {var:1}
escapes the cell and recovers their
belongings, and the two flee through the
tunnel the youth dug to break out...
tm.自分は 勇者の生まれ変わりである。\nその事実を知った {var:1}は\n自ら:
Learning of being the Luminary reborn,
{var:1} leaves Cobblestone and reaches
the kingdom of Heliodor, only to be thrown
in the dungeon as an enemy of the land.
tm.同じく 投獄されていた 謎の青年……カミュの助けにより\n地下水路へと 脱獄を果:
With the help of a fellow prisoner, Erik,
{var:1} breaks out into the sewers and
shakes off Heliodor's soldiers and the black
dragon, but is finally cornered at the edge
of a cliff.
tm.勇者の奇跡を信じるという カミュと共に\n意を決し 崖から飛び降りた {var::
Trusting in the Luminary's luck, as Erik says
to, {var:1} leaps from the cliff. When
Erik wakes them, they're in a church on the
outskirts of Heliodor.
tm.{var:1}とカミュは 追跡するデルカダール兵から\n逃れるため 崖から飛び降:
{var:1} and Erik leapt from a cliff to
escape Heliodor's soldiers. Waking in the
Chapel of Guidance, the pair decide to take
back roads to {var:1}'s home,
Cobblestone, avoiding Hendrik.
tm.カミュは イシの村までの道案内を引き受ける代わりに\n一度 デルカダール城下町へ:
Erik agrees to guide {var:1} to
Cobblestone, in return for help recovering
something he left in Heliodor. With Erik in
the party, {var:1} visits Downtown
Heliodor.
tm.カミュの忘れ物とは レッドオーブと呼ばれる\nデルカダール王家に伝わる 秘宝のこ:
What Erik left behind is the red orb, a
treasure of Heliodor's royal family. But it's
gone from its hiding place. Suspecting his
old sidekick Derk, Erik and {var:1} go
looking for him.
tm.しかし 村に戻る前に カミュが隠したという\nレッドオーブを取り戻すこととなる。:
Before returning to the village, they must
recover the red orb Erik hid. It's not in its
hiding place, and Erik suspects his old
sidekick Derk, so {var:1} visits Erik's old
lodging house for clues.
tm.デルカダール城下町の下層にある下宿を\n切り盛りしている女将は 不在で\nデクに:
The landlady who runs the lodging house in
Downtown Heliodor is out, so there are no
leads on Derk. {var:1} and Erik split up
to look for her.
tm.城下町の下層で 下宿を切り盛りしている女将は 不在で\nデクにつながる有力な情報:
The landlady is out, so there are no leads
on Derk. The pair split up to search, and
{var:1}, keeping watch from the tower in
Downtown, spots her.
tm.下宿に戻ってきた女将に話を聞いた ふたりは\nデクが デルカダール城の近くで 店:
The landlady, now back, tells them Derk has
opened a shop near Heliodor Castle, so the
pair head up into the upper town.
tm.{var:1}とカミュは デルカダール城下町の下層に\nレッドオーブを取りにきた:
{var:1} and Erik came to Downtown
Heliodor for the red orb, but it was gone.
Suspecting Derk, they learn from the
landlady where his shop is and head up into
Heliodor.
tm.ふたりはデクを見つけ カミュは オーブの件で怒るが\nデクは ふたりを歓迎する。:
They find Derk, and Erik is furious about the
orb, but Derk welcomes them. He took the
orb to return it to Heliodor, hoping to soften
the King and save Erik from execution.
tm.かつての舎弟の気づかいに 感謝するカミュ。\nデクから 今は イシの村の先にある:
Erik thanks his old sidekick. Learning that
the orb is now kept in the Kingsbarrow
beyond Cobblestone, the pair head through
the Manglegrove towards Cobblestone, as
first planned.
tm.レッドオーブが デルカダール神殿にあるという情報を\nデクから聞いた {var::
Told by Derk that the red orb is in the
Kingsbarrow, {var:1} and Erik slip out of
Heliodor past the guards. In the
Manglegrove, they find a strange root.
tm.{var:1}が 根に手を触れると\n光と共に 不思議な光景が現れる。\nその光:
When {var:1} touches the root, a vision
appears in a flash of light: a monster
wrecked the bridge, turned the woodcutter
into a dog, and hid in a treasure chest.
tm.宝箱のもとへ向かった ふたりが その魔物を倒すと\n犬に姿を変えられていた木こり:
The pair defeat the monster, and the
woodcutter, human again, repairs the
bridge. The vision is said to be Yggdrasil's
guidance, a miracle seen only by the
chosen.
tm.レッドオーブが デルカダール神殿にあるという情報を\nデクから聞いた {var::
Told by Derk that the red orb is in the
Kingsbarrow, {var:1} and Erik cross the
Manglegrove into the Heliodor region.
Evading Heliodor's soldiers, the pair reach
Cobblestone.
tm.さっそく 自分の家に向かった {var:1}だが\n育ての母ペルラは まだ息子は:
{var:1} goes straight home, but Amber
says her son is only six years old and
throws {var:1} out. Then, beneath a tree
in Cobblestone, {var:1} spots a crying
little girl.
tm.少女のもとに向かった {var:1}は スカーフが\n木に引っかかったことで 少:
The girl is crying because her headscarf is
caught in the tree, so {var:1} gets it
down for her. When {var:1} tells the girl,
Gemma, their name, she runs off to lead the
way to someone with the same name.
tm.さっそく 自分の家に向かった {var:1}だが\n育ての母ペルラは まだ息子は:
{var:1} goes home, but Amber says her
son is only six and throws {var:1} out.
Then a girl named Gemma leads {var:1}
to meet their younger self and grandfather
Chalky, still alive.
tm.{var:1}や 人を恨んじゃいけないよ。\n最後の言葉を {var:1}に言い:
"Don't waste your time bearing grudges,
lad." Leaving {var:1} with these last
words, Chalky slowly fades away.
tm.デルカダール兵の目を逃れ たどり着いたイシの村は\n村にある大樹の根が 勇者のチ:
The Cobblestone the pair reached was a
vision of the past, shown when the village's
great root reacted to the Luminary's power.
The real Cobblestone had been burnt to the
ground by Heliodor's soldiers...
tm.{var:1}は 悲しみを胸に\n過去のイシの村で出会った 祖父テオの助言にした:
With a heavy heart, {var:1} follows the
advice of grandfather Chalky, met in the
Cobblestone of the past, and heads for the
three-sided rock at Cobblestone Falls.
tm.過去のイシの村で受けた テオの助言にしたがい\n{var:1}は イシの大滝に向:
Following Chalky's advice, {var:1} digs
beneath the three-sided rock at
Cobblestone Falls and finds a letter from
their real mother, the Queen of Dundrasil,
one from Chalky, and a Keystone.
tm.なぜ {var:1}は追われる勇者となったのか\nふたりは 真実を求める冒険への:
The pair resolve to seek the truth of why
{var:1} became a hunted Luminary. But
first, at Erik's request, they head for the
Kingsbarrow, where the red orb is kept.
tm.レッドオーブを手に入れた {var:1}とカミュ。\n過去のイシの村で 祖父テオ:
{var:1} and Erik have the red orb.
Following Chalky's advice, the pair also
found a letter from the Queen of Dundrasil,
a letter from Chalky, and a Keystone said to
open the Door of Departure.
tm.なぜ 自分が悪魔の子と呼ばれ\n追われる勇者となったのか すべての真実を求めるた:
To learn the whole truth of why they are
called the Darkspawn and hunted as the
Luminary, {var:1} heads for the Door of
Departure with Erik.
tm.そこへ 突如現れた グレイグ率いるデルカダール兵が\n追撃を仕掛けてくるが まほ:
Hendrik and his soldiers suddenly appear
and give chase, but the Keystone opens the
door and the pair escape. Through the
travel door, {var:1} and Erik arrive in a
vast, empty wilderness.
tm.グレイグ率いる デルカダール兵の追撃を振り切り\n旅立ちのほこらから 見知らぬ地:
Escaping Hendrik and his soldiers,
{var:1} and Erik pass through the Door
of Departure to an unknown land. In the
village of Hotto, they stop at the bathhouse
to wash off the dust of the road.
tm.蒸し風呂へ向かう途中で {var:1}は\n赤い服を着た少女が 酒場に入ろうとし:
On the way to the bathhouse, {var:1}
sees a girl in red being stopped from
entering the bar. She seems curious about
{var:1}, but leaves, saying she must look
for her missing sister.
tm.蒸し風呂で休んでいた {var:1}とカミュは\nルコという 迷子の少女と出会う:
Resting in the bathhouse, {var:1} and
Erik meet a lost girl named Connie. Thinking
she may be the sister the girl outside the
bar was looking for, they leave to reunite
them.
tm.グレイグ率いる デルカダール兵の追撃を振り切り\n見知らぬ地へたどり着いた {v:
Escaping Heliodor's soldiers to an unknown
land, {var:1} and Erik stop to rest in
Hotto's bathhouse. There they meet a lost
girl, Connie, and look for Veronica, who they
think is her family.
tm.しかし 妹を探していた少女 ベロニカは\nルコが探していた家族ではなかった。\n:
But Veronica, who is looking for her sister,
is not Connie's family. Veronica suggests
going with {var:1} and Erik to ask at the
bar, so the pair head there with Connie and
Veronica.
tm.グレイグ率いる デルカダール兵の追撃を振り切り\n見知らぬ地へたどり着いた {v:
Escaping Heliodor's soldiers to an unknown
land, {var:1} and Erik stop at Hotto's
bathhouse. While looking for the family of a
lost girl, Connie, they meet Veronica, a girl
searching for her sister.
tm.なんでも ベロニカは 一度 魔物にさらわれ\n魔物のアジトから 逃げだしてきたの:
Veronica had been kidnapped by monsters
and escaped their lair, only to miss her
sister Serena. So {var:1} and Erik set
off with Veronica, a magician from Arboria,
to find Serena.
tm.魔物にさらわれた ベロニカが逃げだしたことを知らず\n入れ違いになった彼女の妹:
Not knowing Veronica had escaped, her
sister Serena went looking for her.
Searching the monsters' labyrinth, the
three find a grown woman lying
unconscious. Veronica runs to her.
tm.なんと その女性こそ ベロニカの妹 セーニャであった。\nふたりは 本来 同じ見:
The woman is Veronica's sister, Serena.
They are twins, but the monsters who took
Veronica drained her age along with her
magic, turning her into a child. The party
heads deeper to get it back.
tm.{var:1}とカミュは ベロニカの頼みで\n迷宮へ向かい ベロニカの妹である:
At Veronica's request, {var:1} and Erik
find her sister Serena in the labyrinth.
Learning that monsters drained Veronica's
magic and age, they press deeper to
recover her magic.
tm.迷宮の奥で 魔力を奪ったデンダを倒したことで\nベロニカに魔力が戻ったが 年齢ま:
Defeating Jarvis in the depths restores
Veronica's magic, but not her age. At her
request to help someone else, {var:1}
and company head for another room
reached only from the depths.
tm.{var:1}たちは ベロニカの頼みで 迷宮へと向かい\nベロニカの妹 セーニャ:
In the labyrinth, the party finds Serena,
recovers Veronica's magic and rescues
Noah, the father of Connie, the lost girl in
Hotto. Then they return to the village to
rest.
tm.{var:1}は ベロニカとセーニャが勇者を導く使者で\nかつて 邪悪の神を倒し:
Veronica and Serena tell {var:1} they
are guides for the Luminary, and that
{var:1} is the reborn hero who once
defeated the Dark One. The party heads to
the bar to ask Noah about Yggdrasil.
tm.{var:1}は ベロニカの双子の妹 セーニャとも出会い\nふたりが勇者を導く使:
Meeting Veronica's twin Serena, {var:1}
learns they are guides for the Luminary,
and that {var:1} is the Luminary reborn.
To learn why, the party resolves to head for
Yggdrasil.
tm.命の大樹へ向かう手がかりを求めた {var:1}たちは\n情報屋のルパスから サ:
Seeking a way to Yggdrasil, the party hears
from Noah that he saw a rainbow-coloured
branch in the kingdom of Gallopolis. With
Veronica and Serena in the party, they set
out for Gallopolis.
tm.勇者を導く 一族の末裔である\nベロニカとセーニャを仲間に加えた {var:1}:
With Veronica and Serena in the party,
{var:1} learns Yggdrasil may reveal the
Luminary's secret. Hearing a branch of the
great tree is kept in Gallopolis, the party
visits the kingdom.
tm.しかし 肝心のサマディー王は ファーリス杯の準備に\n心を奪われ まったく取りあ:
The king is too busy with the Sand National
to listen. Prince Faris appears, says the
branch is the national treasure called the
Rainbough, and promises to talk in his
chambers.
tm.王子の私室に向かった一行は 頼みを聞いてくれれば\n枝をゆずるよう 王に掛けあう:
In his chambers, Faris offers to speak to
the king about the branch if they do him a
favor. They'll talk at the circus show, so
{var:1} is asked to come to the tent that
night.
tm.命の大樹へ行く手がかりとなる 虹色の枝を求めて\nサマディー王国を訪れた {va:
Seeking the Rainbough, {var:1} and
company visit Gallopolis. Prince Faris offers
to speak to the king in return for a favor, to
be explained at the circus show.
tm.なんでも 王子は 次のレースに主役として出場するのだが\nじつは ウマに乗って走:
The prince is to star in the next race, yet
has never ridden a horse. He asks
{var:1}, who has his build, to stand in as
a body double, in return for a word with the
king.
tm.命の大樹へ行く手がかりとなる 虹色の枝を求めて\nサマディー王国を訪れた {va:
Seeking the Rainbough, {var:1} and
company visit Gallopolis. In exchange for
the king's ear, {var:1} will run the race
as a body double for Faris, who can't ride.
tm.王子に変装し レースを走り切った {var:1}だったが\nレース後 旅芸人のシ:
{var:1} runs the race disguised as the
prince, but the wandering entertainer
Sylvando sees through it. He lectures the
prince that knights fight fair, but Faris
won't listen.
tm.そこへ 王子に サマディー王からの招集がかかる。\nファーリス王子は レースを代:
Then the king summons the prince. Faris
promises to ask the king to give {var:1}
the Rainbough as thanks for running in his
place, and heads for the throne room.
tm.見事 レースを走り切った {var:1}は\n虹色の枝を受け取るため サマディー:
{var:1} goes to the king for the
Rainbough, but news comes of a monster,
the Slayer of the Sands. The king, pleased
with the prince's riding, orders Faris to
capture it.
tm.突然の命令に震えあがる ファーリス王子。\n王の命令を承諾するが 虹色の枝の話は:
Prince Faris trembles at the sudden order.
He accepts, but says the Rainbough must
wait, and asks {var:1} to come to his
chambers before leaving the throne room.
tm.{var:1}たちが 王子の私室へ行くと\nファーリスは 土下座の姿勢で待ちかま:
In the prince's chambers, Faris is waiting on
his knees, begging for help capturing the
monster. If it works, he swears he'll talk
about the Rainbough, so the party agrees.
tm.見事 レースを走り切り 城へ向かった {var:1}。\nところが レースでの王:
After the race, {var:1} finds the king
has ordered the inexperienced Faris to
capture a monster. Begged for help again,
{var:1} reluctantly agrees.
tm.王子と兵士たちの出発を見送り 外へ出ようとした一行だが\nそこへ 旅芸人シルビア:
As the party sees the prince off, the
wandering entertainer Sylvando appears
and offers to help capture the Slayer of the
Sands. Together they set out for the
Celestial Sands.
tm.虹色の枝を求めて サマディー王国を訪れた\n{var:1}たちは ファーリス王子:
Seeking the Rainbough, {var:1} and
company agree to help Prince Faris
capture the Slayer of the Sands. Sylvando,
curious about the prince, joins them for the
Celestial Sands.
tm.道中にあるキャンプ地で 休みをとった その夜……\nシルビアは {var:1}た:
That night at a campsite, Sylvando learns
of {var:1}'s journey and shows interest,
but says nothing of himself and falls asleep.
At dawn, the party heads deeper into the
Celestial Sands.
tm.砂漠の殺し屋 デスコピオンの捕獲に成功し\n気をよくした王子は 今度こそ 虹色の:
The Slayer of the Sands is captured, and
the prince promises to speak to the king
about the Rainbough at last. Sylvando
warns him that honor won this way means
nothing, but Faris returns to the castle.
tm.ファーリス王子の態度に あきれる一行。\nそんな中 王子は 今の自分に満足してな:
The party is dismayed by Faris's attitude.
Sylvando leaves, hinting that the prince
isn't satisfied with himself, and {var:1}
and company follow Faris back to
Gallopolis.
tm.虹色の枝を求めて サマディー王国を訪れた\n{var:1}たちは ファーリス王子:
Seeking the Rainbough, {var:1} and
company help Prince Faris and Sylvando
capture the Slayer of the Sands. But the
monster breaks loose and begins rampaging
through the town.
tm.町が混乱におちいる中 王子なら なんとかしてくれると\n民は声援を送るが 当の本:
The town is in chaos and the people cheer
for their prince, but he freezes in fear.
Roused by Sylvando, he stands up to the
beast, and Sylvando finishes it in one blow
and leaves.
tm.反省した王子は 王に 今までのことをすべて明かし\n{var:1}たちに 虹色の:
Chastened, the prince confesses
everything to the king and begs him to give
{var:1} the Rainbough. The king admits
he sold it to a merchant, so the party
leaves to trace him.
tm.シルビアのゲキを受け 勇敢に戦う 王子を見届けると\nシルビアは 魔物を一撃で倒:
Having watched the prince fight bravely,
Sylvando fells the monster and leaves.
Faris, now reflective, begs the king to give
{var:1} the Rainbough, only to learn it
was sold.
tm.虹色の枝を買ったという 行商人を追い\n出発する一行であったが そこへ シルビア:
As the party sets off after the merchant,
Sylvando reappears, shares his dream, and
joins them. He offers his ship to track the
Rainbough, and they head for Gondolia.
tm.虹色の枝を求めて ダーハルーネの町を訪れた\n{var:1}たちは シルビアの船:
Seeking the Rainbough, {var:1} and
company reach Gondolia, but the dock
holding Sylvando's ship is closed for the
Mighty Man contest. {var:1} and Erik go
to ask the mayor.

tm.町長に追い返されてしまった {var:1}とカミュは\n町の少年に杖を奪われたと:
Turned away by the mayor, {var:1} and
Erik find Veronica, whose wand a boy stole.
To cure the mayor's cursed, voiceless son,
they take Rad's request and seek songbird
nectar.
tm.町長に追い返された {var:1}とカミュは\n町長の息子である少年 ヤヒムが\:
Turned away by the mayor, {var:1} and
Erik learn his son lost his voice to a curse.
With the songbird nectar needed to lift it,
the party returns to Gondolia.

tm.町に戻り シルビアたちは さえずりのみつを届けに\n{var:1}とカミュは コ:
Back in town, {var:1} and Erik go to
claim a spot for the contest, but General
Jasper of Heliodor spots them. {var:1}
escapes with friends' help, then sets out to
rescue Erik.
tm.町長に追い返された {var:1}とカミュは\n呪いで声を失ったという 町長の息:
Turned away by the mayor, {var:1} and
Erik meet his voiceless son. {var:1}
leaves the nectar with the others, but
Jasper finds them at the contest and
captures Erik.
tm.捕らわれたカミュを助け 船で町を脱出する一行だったが\nホメロスが操る魔物に 船:
The party rescues Erik and flees Gondolia
by ship, but a monster under Jasper's
control threatens to sink it. The mayor, his
son healed, arrives to save them as they
head out to sea.
